scope: Existing 16-photo-adapted U2NETP and cached actual browser fields, unchanged fitting and validation settings. Whole-body crop selection only; no retraining, numerical-tolerance changes or production model integration. Both fixed development cohorts retain every unresolved/failing case.

validation.applicationScope: No src/ or static/ changes. Complete release evidence remains conni-release-qa.json.

angel.meaning: The full overlap is now selected; its ring and angel silhouette are recognizable. Minor curve imperfections remain. Error is against the new RGB-derived crop target, not identical pixels or original cutting ground truth.

fragmentaryBird.meaning: The previously misleading small-fragment crop is retained for editing but flagged by the new body evidence. No supported replacement was found; do not count this as whole-heart success.

checkerRegression.reason: Balanced foreground/background confidence corrects the first metric’s treatment of uncertain foreground. Thresholds stay fixed.

findings.remaining: Printed paper and glare still corrupt RGB-derived targets; stacked-heart fits retain thin false seams. The NN itself may miss paper or include hands/handles, so whole-body evidence is an additional check, not ground truth.

visualReview.observations: All 15 fresh candidate comparisons inspected across five pages. Angel improved; checker restored. Stacked-heart extra seams, Cthulhu reflection artifacts, printed-tree and decorated-paper failures persist. Reused production comparisons were inspected in expanded-evaluation-results.json.

next: Replace the research adapter’s source injection with an explicit locator field-provider API, then verify the same crop decisions in the actual worker/UI flow with model loading and cancellation. The model is not deployed by this experiment; preserve failed raw numerical parity separately.
